resolution: Adds .claude/agents/ (rf-builder; rf-verifier, rf-reviewer and rf-acceptance-auditor with no Edit or Write tool), .claude/workflows/rf-ticket.js (stages 2–6: build, verify and review, at most two fix rounds, then publish or park; it never merges, applies owner-approved or sets Ready), pnpm tasks eligible and pnpm tasks stats with tests, .claude/worktrees/ in .gitignore, and the commands, agents and workflow in rf-pipeline.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and the task README. Acceptance line 2 was narrowed by the conductor's brief: eligible does not run owner-gate, which stays the conductor's stage 1 and §7.3 check. The agents and the workflow have not run live yet; the first ticket run through them is their live check.
title: RF pipeline tooling: Claude Code agent definitions, a saved rf-ticket workflow, and pnpm tasks eligible and stats
acceptance: .claude/agents/ defines the pipeline's builder, verifier, correctness reviewer and acceptance auditor (reviewers and the verifier cannot edit product code), and .claude/workflows/rf-ticket runs one ticket through agent-prompts/rf-pipeline.md stages 2–6 with at most two fix rounds; .claude/worktrees/ is git-ignored.

pnpm tasks eligible lists Backlog and Ready tasks whose dependsOn are Done, whose kind is task, and whose acceptance names no owner-only check; the owner-gate result for a candidate's predicted files stays the conductor's stage 1 check (node scripts/owner-gate.mjs), which eligible does not run (narrowed by the conductor's RF-250 brief, 2026-11-24). pnpm tasks stats reports RF records created and finished per week. Both have cases in scripts/tasks.test.mjs.
agent-prompts/rf-pipeline.md and CLAUDE.md name the new commands and agents.

evidence.summary: pnpm tasks:test passed 15 of 15 on this branch, including eligible filtering and order, owner-only acceptance wording, stats per ISO week from a synthetic git log, and stats through a real git repository.

pnpm tasks stats on this branch: 248 records created and 146 finished in all (the 144 Done plus 2 Cancelled records); since 2026-11-02, 76 created and 44 finished, which is RF-248's measured baseline (72 and 43) plus RF-248 to RF-251 created and RF-248 finished on this branch.

node --check passed on the body wrapped as the Workflow runtime runs it and on the meta literal as its own module (the raw file fails only on the runtime's top-level return). A dry run with mocked agents passed the blocked, clean, fix-then-publish (head-mismatch re-run, batch mode), two-rounds-then-park, missing-stage and no-new-commit paths. It was not run through the Workflow tool.
pnpm format:check, owner-gate:test (22 of 22), rf-trace:test (5 of 5), lint and git diff --check passed on this branch. No app or package code changed, so the rest of the gate was not run.
